supersedes: Nothing. The floor falsifier measured at 8f49652f: the count leg PASSES at Theta 1e6 (takeoff 19/20, q05-q95 [149, 760] contains 197, med 331) while the timing leg fails below-side (before_share med 0.051 < the 0.073 floor). The 'mechanism-shaped count floor' projection was falsified — the band IS reachable under shipped defaults. The clause is now squeezed on two different legs in opposite directions: count passes only below the q05=197 crossing, timing only above the before_share=0.073 crossing, both inside (1e6, 1e7). This design locates the two crossings and asks whether a simultaneously-passing theta exists between them.
description: THETA-REFIT-01 bracket refine: five 20-seed rows at Theta 1.4e6 / 2e6 / 3.16e6 / 5.62e6 / 7.9e6 filling the (1e6, 1e7) decade interior, on the verbatim v11-lineage replay contract under shipped defaults (caregiver on, propensity party). Measured boundary values: at 1e6 the count leg passes ([149,760] ∋ 197) and the timing leg fails (0.051 < 0.073); at 1e7 the count leg fails (q05 523 > 197) and the timing leg passes (0.097). If the leg-crossings are ordered theta_t <= theta_c an admissible window exists and a row may clause-pass (LOCATED); if theta_t > theta_c no interior theta can pass and the squeeze is certified (EMPTY). Rows failing both legs sit wherever the two fails overlap.

Engine identity across the image window measured twice: e0d43979..b932d0e9 touched no engine code (D0_declared replicated the e0d43979 canary bit-identically, max |delta| = 0 on 20 seeds), and b932d0e9..this branch touches no engine code (docs/, tools/, deploy/aws/, noro manifests only — verified by git diff --stat). The 1e9 row is therefore a replication row: it must reproduce the attribution run's D0_declared row bit-identically, and any divergence is an image/drift defect, not a sim result.
QUAR-ATTR-V2 on the post-721 base measured Theta 1e9 (3,365 / 0.9068) — the working anchor this design refits; it stays a boundary row, reported beside the clause, never selected.
voyage_mode_note: Declared replay, verbatim from the v11->v15 stage-2 lineage and covid_caregiver_off_v1: index onset_day -1.0, departure_day 5.0, dwell_weighted sanitary visits, imports 1, infection_age_days 6.8, 20 matched seeds at base 20200205, full 32-day voyage (768 epochs). The clause is a replay-contract criterion; the generic-voyage fleet stage is not in this design.
thetas_note: Five interior rows on (1e6, 1e7): quarter-decade log spacing between the measured boundary values. The clause question is ordering: theta_t (the theta where takeoff before_share reaches the 0.073 timing floor from below) vs theta_c (the theta where takeoff q05 climbs above 197 from below). 1.4e6 sits just above the measured count-leg-passing floor; 7.9e6 just below the measured timing-leg-passing ceiling; the middle three resolve where the crossings land relative to each other.
infection_age_note: The declared value, carried for cell-key bookkeeping only: under a declared onset_day the infection age is a measured null axis (COVID-SEED-GEOM-01).
seeds_note: The same 20 matched seeds at the same base as every stage-2 surface since v11 and both attribution canaries — every cell pairs seed-for-seed with the v15 anchor row (campaign/covid_theta_screen_v15_stage2/6efec855/cells/), the PROPENSITY-V1 canary (campaign/covid_propensity_v1/e0d43979/cells/), and the CAREGIVER-ATTR-01 arms (campaign/covid_caregiver_off_v1/b932d0e9/cells/).

arms.note: The shipped default verbatim: caregiver on (cleanup + tending + service), propensity party cv 0.8, presentation once_per_course, hand hygiene_cycle — first arm so empty overrides per the arm grammar, and the same arm_id the PROPENSITY-V1 canary and CAREGIVER-ATTR-01 ran, so this sweep's rows are the mechanism surface of record at each Theta.

cells_note: 5 Theta x 1 arm x 20 seeds = 100 declared-replay cells (~30 min each). Indices 0-19 = Theta 1.4e6, 20-39 = 2e6, 40-59 = 3.16e6, 60-79 = 5.62e6, 80-99 = 7.9e6. Submitted as one 100-cell array, INDEX_OFFSET 0.

admissibility.note: FROZEN before any cell exists. The conditional_trajectory_clause and index_geometry audit invariant are carried verbatim from the v11 lineage / covid_theta_refit_v1; the verdict grammar below is the falsifier grammar — this is a one-row boundary certification, not a candidate row.

conditional_trajectory_clause.criterion: Verbatim from v11: among takeoff seeds (recorded_onsets >= 10), the q05-q95 interval of recorded_onsets contains 197 AND the takeoff-seed median before_share is within 0.10 of 0.173 (34/197 onsets before day 17, 6 February); scored only when the row has >= 5 takeoff seeds, else reported as 'insufficient takeoff mass'.
conditional_trajectory_clause.note: Scored per row on every submitted Theta — the design's whole point is the row-resolved clause map on the shipped-default tree. Reported beside it, never thresholded: takeoff-seed count per row, fraction of takeoff seeds with recorded_onsets in [98.5, 394] (mass-near-197), the per-seed recorded_onsets and before_share vectors, takeoff infections_total, and the pooled caregiver-route dose tallies per row (the mechanism's own scaling signature in Theta).

index_geometry.criterion: AUDIT INVARIANT verbatim: index_onset_day == -1.0 and index_shedding_at_day0 true in 100% of every cell's seeds; deviation invalidates the cell.
index_geometry.reads: the seeded host's own onset and shedding record

audit_invariants.caregiver: delivery.caregiver.mode resolves 'on' on every cell — the mechanism under test is the shipped default; a missing or mismatched echo is a design defect, not a sim result, and halts the campaign before readout. Reported beside it, never gated: the caregiver-route dose tally (aboard_window_by_route/during_quarantine_by_route 'caregiver' key), expected >0 on takeoff cells and reported per row as the dose-scaling witness.
audit_invariants.participation_propensity: delivery.participation_propensity.mode resolves 'party' on every cell — the shipped default; a missing or mismatched echo is a design defect.
audit_invariants.propensity_draw: propensity_draw.units_drawn > 0 on every cell — the draw-landing witness.

admissibility.verdict_grammar: Bracket verdict, frozen before any cell runs: (a) LOCATED — >= 1 row clause-passes (both legs): the window is nonempty; the passing row is the new anchor candidate and is reported with its leg margins and seed-paired deltas vs the stale 1e9 anchor; (b) WINDOW-EMPTY-ORDERED — no row clause-passes and the leg-failures order cleanly (every count-leg fail sits at a theta at or above every timing-leg-only fail): theta_t > theta_c, the squeeze is certified, no admissible theta exists in (1e6, 1e7); (c) WINDOW-EMPTY-INTERLEAVED — no row clause-passes but failing legs interleave non-monotonically across the rows (a count fail below a timing fail): the monotone picture was wrong; report the actual leg map rather than extrapolate a window; (d) SUB-IGNITION — any row scores fewer than 5 takeoff seeds: that row unscored; record its ignition margin and report which side the fired seeds' distributions sat on. On every verdict, the seed-paired deltas against the refit 1e7 and 1e6 rows, the v15 anchor row, and both attribution arms are reported beside it.

diagnostics.boundary_rows: The five interior rows pair seed-for-seed against both measured boundaries — the refit 1e7 row (campaign/covid_theta_refit_v1/78f52a58/cells/ indices 0-19) and the floor 1e6 row (campaign/covid_theta_refit_floor_v1/8f49652f/cells/) — the bracket's two known endpoints.
diagnostics.paired_vs_v15_anchor: Every row pairs seed-for-seed with the v15 stage-2 anchor row (campaign/covid_theta_screen_v15_stage2/6efec855/cells/ cells 0-19) and both CAREGIVER-ATTR-01 arms (campaign/covid_caregiver_off_v1/b932d0e9/cells/) — the pre-caregiver reference and the off-tree pass region.
diagnostics.leg_crossings: Per row: does the count leg (q05 <= 197 <= q95) or timing leg (|bshr med - 0.173| <= 0.10) fail, and on which side — the ordering of the two crossings in theta is the whole question.
diagnostics.caregiver_route_witness: aboard_window_by_route / during_quarantine_by_route 'caregiver' tallies pooled per row — expected to persist in the ~100-140 floor range across the bracket; monotone theta-scaling resumes only outside the floor regime.
diagnostics.mass_near_197: fraction of takeoff seeds recording in [98.5, 394] — 0.474 at 1e6, expected to fall back toward 0 as theta climbs toward the 1e7 wall; the row where mass_near_197 peaks is where the count band is tightest around 197.

execution.platform: AWS Batch via deploy/aws/submit_covid_boarding_screen.sh with DESIGN=covid_theta_refit_bracket_v1, INDEX_OFFSET 0, ARRAY_SIZE 100, STRIDE 1 on the On-Demand queue picard-analysis-queue (Fargate fallback picard-covid-boarding-screen-fargate on picard-analysis-fargate-queue). Image is a thin overlay deploy/aws/Dockerfile.covid_theta_refit_bracket FROM picard-campaign:campaign-e0d43979-refit-floor + COPY of this design file — engine-identical to the refit generation by construction.
execution.canary: None: the pipeline, image lineage, and index geometry are already proven by the 200 preceding cells of this campaign at the same defaults; the floor probe's 20/20 success on the same queue/image-family is the warm-start. All 100 cells submit in one array.
execution.report_immediately_if: any row clause-passes (LOCATED — the verdict overturns inside the measured gap); the caregiver or propensity echo fails to resolve on any cell (delivery.caregiver or delivery.participation_propensity missing or mode mismatched — a design defect, not a sim result); any cell's index_onset_day or index_shedding_at_day0 fails the audit invariant; propensity_draw.units_drawn <= 0 on any cell; any row scores fewer than 5 takeoff seeds; or the child failure rate exceeds 5%.

rejected_alternatives.single_probe_at_midpoint: REJECTED: one row at 3.16e6 could pass and still leave the window's width unmeasured — the interesting case (theta_t > theta_c, no window) needs the leg-order resolved across the decade, which needs >= 3 rows; 5 gives the crossing locations to ~quarter-decade precision for the same wall-clock (one array).
rejected_alternatives.finer_than_quarter_decade: REJECTED: eighth-decade spacing (7+ rows) buys leg-order precision the clause doesn't reward — a pass needs only one passing row, and an EMPTY verdict is certified by the ordering, not the grid density.
rejected_alternatives.widen_below_1e6: REJECTED: the measured boundary already brackets the question — below 1e6 heads toward fizzle (the floor probe's 19/20 takeoff is the last well-igniting row by extrapolation); extending down reads ignition mechanics, not the leg squeeze.
